intro: Every map's difficulty, what makes it tricky, where to build and which towers the community guides recommend. Pick a game mode to add that mode's rules and general advice; some maps have notes for a specific mode.

maps.name: Alpine Run
maps.summary: A ski slope split by a lift. The track is spread out, so it's on the harder side for a Beginner map.
maps.placement: Place towers around the centre of the middle lane; high-pierce towers that use straight lines shine.

recommended.note: Between the centre and the last bend, its press reaches almost the whole map with Stronger Stimulant and Primary Training.
Near the exit, 2-0-5 BEZ with camo, lead popping and Stronger Stimulant handles the late game.

maps.name: Candy Falls
maps.summary: One of the longest and easiest maps; almost any strategy works in every mode.
maps.placement: Boats in the central river get attacked from above and below at once.

recommended.note: Near the centre both gun sides fire; five 3-1-0/3-2-0 Destroyers (or a Carrier Flagship) with Brickell and camo save up to Permanent Brew easily.

maps.name: Carved
maps.summary: A jack-o'-lantern shaped track; long and compact, so on the easier side.
maps.placement: The spot below where the pumpkin's mouth meets its outline sees bloons pass twice; the right water patch is also strong.

recommended.note: The double pass over the kill zone amplifies them; pair with Berserker Brew (Tack Zone also with Embrittlement and Primary Training).
The same spot maximises its spinning glaives.

maps.name: Cubism
maps.summary: Widely seen as the 4th easiest map: very long with excellent central spots.
maps.placement: Use the small shapes in the middle, just left of centre.

recommended.note: Place it near the top of a small shape so the kill zone sits on the track; add Berserker Brew and Geraldo.

maps.name: End Of The Road
maps.summary: The shortest Beginner map, but very open, which makes it good for farming.
maps.placement: The central pool is surrounded by track on both sides.

recommended.note: In the pool both gun sides fire often; five 3-1-0/3-2-0 Destroyers with Brickell and camo afford Permanent Brew, which then trivialises the late game.

maps.name: Four Circles
maps.summary: One of the least difficult maps thanks to its length and a central spot that covers four sectors.
maps.placement: Take the central spot first.

recommended.note: From the centre its attacks run down many straight lines and its press covers nearly the whole map.
Spinning glaives clean up clumps and its ricochets bounce around the whole map.

maps.name: Frozen Over
maps.summary: One of the easiest maps: long, with lots of loops and good spots.
maps.placement: Put loop-based towers near the top of a loop; the cliff fits a Village or Super Monkey.

recommended.note: Loops are its best placement; add Berserker Brew and Geraldo.
Left of the central water spot it reaches most of the map.

maps.name: Hedge
maps.summary: Among the hardest Beginner maps because of the hedges.
maps.placement: Use towers that ignore or see over walls (Heli Pilots, Wizards from 1-x-x).

recommended.note: Balls bounce off the walls; use 5-2-0 with Berserker Brew and camo, placed to see through a hedge gap.
Ignores the walls; pair with Geraldo's Sharpening Stone and Glue Storm.
Its undead bloons use the long track regardless of walls.

maps.name: In The Loop
maps.summary: Average Beginner difficulty: long but spread out.
maps.placement: The central spot lets long-range towers hit three or more passes.

recommended.note: From the centre it covers the map and wipes the late game.
Bottom-left of the lake with a Grape Shot crosspath to use the wide loops.

maps.name: Logs
maps.summary: Considered the easiest map in the game and the best Freeplay map; bloons under the logs can still be hit.
maps.placement: The central pond and middle spots cover almost everything.

recommended.note: 3-2-0 in the central pond with Berserker Brew and camo carries the mid game and saves for a win condition (Glaive Lord, Pirate Lord).

modeNotes.chimps: Holds the cheapest CHIMPS clear on record: only Corvus and one 0-0-0 Dart ($1,215 spent).
modeNotes.freeplay: The wiki's recommended Freeplay map: room for 38 Banana Farms and a full Ninja army.

maps.name: Lotus Island
maps.summary: Seen as the second-hardest Beginner map: short, spread out and blocked.
maps.placement: Land towers right of the lower-middle loop; water towers just left and right of it.

recommended.note: Overcomes the spread-out track and buffs the many water towers this map allows.

maps.name: Middle of the Road
maps.summary: One of the hardest Beginner maps: the most line-of-sight-restricted of them.
maps.placement: Global-range towers excel; the water tower near the top-right holds one big tower.

recommended.note: On the water tower it covers the whole map; with MIB the 2-0-5 beats the late game, saving up from BADS.

maps.name: Monkey Meadow
maps.summary: The first map in the menu and a generic layout where almost anything works.
maps.placement: The centre, just below the top enclosed patch, gives the widest coverage.

recommended.note: In the middle its spinning and ricochet glaives cover clumps and the whole map.
Strong mid-game at the central intersections; 0-3-2 needs another tower or hero to cover purple bloons.

maps.name: One Two Tree
maps.summary: A Christmas tree farm where clearing the trees reveals spaces that buff towers placed on them.
maps.placement: Put one-damage towers on +1 damage spaces (for example Druid of the Jungle on space 4 early).

recommended.note: On a +1 damage space its many one-damage hits become huge; Geraldo's Worn Hero's Cape fits several on spaces 16 and 20.

maps.name: Park Path
maps.summary: A BTD5 remaster with a stream through the middle.
maps.placement: Boats in the central water spot; land towers just above and top-right of it.

recommended.note: 3-2-0 with Berserker Brew and camo in the central spot sweeps the mid game and saves for Carrier Flagship.

maps.name: Resort
maps.summary: By consensus the second-easiest map; bloons pass the top lane repeatedly.
maps.placement: The enclosed space top-right of the pool is ideal for loop towers (Tack Shooters, Ice Monkeys).

recommended.note: In the top-right enclosed space, at a corner, she is extremely strong; on release she soloed CHIMPS here.

modeNotes.freeplay: A close second to Logs for Freeplay with Bloonjitsu and Shinobi Tactics.

maps.name: Scrapyard
maps.summary: The longest map, but spread out and cramped, so not the easiest.
maps.placement: Limited-range towers on the top-left box; save room above or top-right of it for a Village.

recommended.note: The wiki's editors call BEZ an easy carry and the most optimal pick here.

maps.name: Skates
maps.summary: Long but spread out, so global-range towers stand out.
maps.placement: Limited-range towers go left of the large middle loop.

recommended.note: Uses the whole map, holds up into the 90s and buffs Destroyers in the central crack.
Below the end of the track its buckshot spreads well; with MIB it clears the late game.

maps.name: Skull Tweak
maps.summary: A BTD5 Skull Peak remix added in v55. The normal layout is easy; the harder dual-lane version plays like an above-average Advanced map.
maps.placement: Flying towers and towers that ignore obstacles work best because of the skull.

recommended.note: Both reach every part of the map regardless of the skull; all paths work.

maps.name: Spa Pits
maps.summary: About the fourth-easiest map: very long with lots of overlap. Space is a bit tight for Freeplay.
maps.placement: Save a spot next to the central pool for a Jungle Drums village; water strategies are especially strong.

recommended.note: Grows smoothly from Destroyer and Aircraft Carrier with huge damage.

modeNotes.freeplay: Only worth it for Freeplay with Destroyer or Aircraft Carrier builds.

maps.name: The Cabin
maps.summary: Widely considered the hardest Beginner map: short, spread out and cramped.
maps.placement: Global-range towers and boats in the pond work best.

recommended.note: Use 5-2-0 here; Destroyer and Aircraft Carrier save up to it comfortably and it buffs other boats.

maps.name: Three Mines 'Round
maps.summary: One of the easiest Beginner maps: the long triple loop gives towers three or four chances at each bloon.
maps.placement: Use spots near the lane intersections rather than the middle of the big loop (unless the tower has area damage).

recommended.note: The cheapest Bananite crystal is almost always worth harvesting; more cost-efficient than early farms.

maps.name: Tinkerton
maps.summary: Above-average Beginner difficulty, but long, and bloons are slowed after the top bend.
maps.placement: Decent-range towers in the middle cover many sections; the one-off rocket can be ignored.

recommended.note: On the central crater it sees four track sections at once.

maps.name: Town Center
maps.summary: One of the hardest Beginner maps: short, spread out and blocked.
maps.placement: Most good strategies use the central space.

recommended.note: From the centre its press reaches almost the whole map.
Covers several sectors from the centre.

maps.name: Tree Stump
maps.summary: Average Beginner difficulty with a spread-out track.
maps.placement: Towers on the central stump ignore the blockers and cover a lot.

recommended.note: On the stump it covers the whole map; 2-0-5 with MIB clears the late game.
Uses the full spread-out length; pair with Geraldo and Glue Storm.

maps.name: Winter Park
maps.summary: Fairly simple when towers cover several sections at once.
maps.placement: Boats at the left or right of the fountain cover four sections; long-range land towers centre-left or centre-right cover three.

recommended.note: The fountain is ringed by track; 3-2-0 with Berserker Brew and camo saves for Carrier Flagship.

maps.name: Adora's Temple
maps.summary: Bloons switch entrances each round and climb the temple steps.
maps.placement: Put win conditions on the two spots at the very top of the temple, which see most of the track.

recommended.note: From a peak spot its press covers practically the whole map.

modeNotes.chimps: Only place towers on the peak spots early if they'll become your win condition, and don't block the peak with lower-layer towers.

maps.name: Ancient Portal
maps.summary: A middle-of-the-road Intermediate map; a portal decides which of two exits bloons take, and pedestals buff heroes.
maps.placement: Towers between the top-right and bottom-right cover both sections well.

recommended.note: The many bends suit it; set the portal to send bloons left for the longer track.

maps.name: Balance
maps.summary: Eight paths meet in a central loop that bloons circle three and a half times, making it one of the easiest Intermediate maps.
maps.placement: Save the spots around the central loop for late-game towers rather than early ones.

recommended.note: Practically perfect here: the loop maximises her pierce and Sword Charge hits the overlapping lanes; add stuns.
The very long loop suits its kill zone.

maps.name: Bazaar
maps.summary: One of the hardest Intermediate maps: the lane switches every round.
maps.placement: The middle section sees both lanes; Heli Pilots do well with one lane per round.

recommended.note: His spirit handles the early game on single-lane rounds and his long range covers most of the map.

maps.name: Bloonarius Prime
maps.summary: Among the hardest Intermediate maps (but easier than Lost Crevasse used to be): few spots cover both lanes.
maps.placement: Corvus at the entrance farms mana all game.

recommended.note: Handles the early game and saves up for expensive win conditions.
Works with many of the best towers here.

maps.name: Chutes
maps.summary: One of the hardest Intermediate maps, arguably harder than some Advanced maps: short alternating lanes and few good spots.
maps.placement: Global towers are the most reliable.

recommended.note: Handles the alternating lanes; with Glue Storm it hits DDTs without MIB, and Geraldo's Sharpening Stone adds pierce.

maps.name: Covered Garden
maps.summary: A rotating glass roof covers three quarters of the garden each round, which makes the first CHIMPS rounds fiddly.
maps.placement: Global towers outside the garden ignore the panels; save cash so towers inside can be upgraded before a panel covers them.

recommended.note: At the front of the track he farms mana untouched by the panels.

maps.name: Cracked
maps.summary: One of the easiest Intermediate maps: long with plenty of bends.
maps.placement: Long-range towers right of the rock cover several sections.

recommended.note: Uses the whole track and saves up comfortably; Commander with Geraldo handles the late game.

maps.name: Downstream
maps.summary: On the easier side of Intermediate: one long lane.
maps.placement: Long-range towers in the open top-middle; Tack Shooters inside the loops; boats right of the track start.

recommended.note: Both gun sides fire from the water right of the start; 3-2-0 with Berserker Brew, then Aircraft Carrier.

maps.name: Encrypted
maps.summary: The small central space inside the crypt walls has by far the best coverage.
maps.placement: Reserve the crypt for important late-game towers, especially in CHIMPS; walls let projectiles bounce.

recommended.note: In the crypt centre with Berserker Brew and Relentless Glue she carries the mid game; two exits double Sword Charge.
Inside the crypt its balls bounce off the walls.

maps.name: Firing Range
maps.summary: Looks cramped at first, but compact and long enough to be fairly simple.
maps.placement: Clear the central outpost for good spots; use the water for boats.

recommended.note: With Grape Shot early, Berserker Brew and camo it dominates the mid game.
The compact track lets its explosions hit huge areas; pair with Striker Jones and stuns.

maps.name: Haunted
maps.summary: One of the harder Intermediate maps: separate entrances, short length and overlapping paths that hide leaks.
maps.placement: The central pond makes water towers excel; the bottom bends suit land towers.

recommended.note: Bloons pass both sides of the pond; five Destroyers (or a Carrier Flagship) with camo and Stronger Stimulant sweep the mid game.

maps.name: KartsNDarts
maps.summary: Widely seen as the second-easiest Intermediate map; bloons pass the loops twice.
maps.placement: Top-left or top-right of the tunnel, between the loops.

recommended.note: From beside the tunnel its press covers almost the whole map; with Primary Training, Radar Scanner and Stronger Stimulant it handles the BAD.

maps.name: Lost Crevasse
maps.summary: Once one of the hardest Intermediate maps; v57 made it easier and it's now average. Bloons from both sides always cross the middle section.
maps.placement: Crowd control in the middle section matters most.

recommended.note: The chokepoint at the front lets her excel early and stay strong late.

maps.name: Luminous Cove
maps.summary: Alternating lanes that meet in a central loop surrounded by water, so water strategies are best.
maps.placement: Water towers around the central loop; Heli Pilots and Carrier Flagship get past the high blocked sections.

recommended.note: Overcomes the line-of-sight blockers and buffs the many water towers.

modeNotes.freeplay: The costly Mermonkey secret only adds water space; worth it mainly for Merchantman income or water Paragons.

maps.name: Moon Landing
maps.summary: Walls make the early game tricky, but the long track makes the rest easy.
maps.placement: Simple starts: Beast Handler 0-0-1 → 0-1-1, a base Alchemist top-left of the first crater, three Dart Monkeys or a Mortar.

recommended.note: Balls bounce around inside the craters; place near a crater entrance on First or its exit on Strong.
Trivialises the single lane with support for DDTs.

maps.name: Polyphemus
maps.summary: Average Intermediate difficulty; the eye in the middle buffs towers placed on it.
maps.placement: Keeping the eye open (about $26,000 to round 100) is worth it; land towers just above and below the eye use the loop.

recommended.note: Wipes the mid game, saves lots of cash and still hits hard in the 90s.

maps.name: Protect The Yacht
traits: Bloons invincible for most of the track
maps.summary: Rated Intermediate but arguably harder than most Advanced and the easiest Expert maps: bloons are invincible for over half the track.
maps.placement: Avoid relying on Tack Shooters, Pat Fusty or Sauda at the only turns, which sit right by the exits.

recommended.note: One of the few stall towers that works here; it also buffs Magic Monkeys, enabling Druid or Shinobi spam.
Covers the remaining track with MOAB-popping spikes.

maps.name: Quarry
maps.summary: One of the easiest Intermediate maps despite the layers: long, bendy and open.
maps.placement: Heli Pilots ignore the elevation walls.

recommended.note: Zombies ignore line-of-sight and have time to spawn; great on R95 DDTs. Pair with Ezili or Corvus.

maps.name: Quiet Street
maps.summary: Hard early and mid game (bloons from both sides), easy late game because blimps use one lane.
maps.placement: BEZ far right covers a wide area.

recommended.note: Spear handles the early game, his spellbook the mid game, and Ancestral Might and Overload stay strong late.
On the far right its spread covers much of the map.

maps.name: Rake
maps.summary: One of the hardest Intermediate maps: two short lanes confuse targeting.
maps.placement: Place towers at or just below the centre, or where the rock was; add cleanup for leaks.

recommended.note: Slightly top-left of the bottom-left enclosure on Smart, with Berserker Brew and Jungle Drums, it covers both exits.
Handles the separated lanes well.

maps.name: Spice Islands
maps.summary: Nearly all water, but a single lane keeps it manageable.
maps.placement: Arctic Wind lets land towers stand on water.

recommended.note: Naval Tactics gives water towers attack speed, pierce, camo and normal damage; Mega Mines delete RBE and DDTs.

maps.name: Spring Spring
maps.summary: On the harder side of Intermediate: two separate paths loop round the islands.
maps.placement: Place near the right end of the large island; add a global blimp-breaker (Aircraft Carrier) to stagger blimp insides.

recommended.note: At the back its spinning glaives clean up and its thrown glaives bounce along the whole track.

maps.name: Streambed
maps.summary: Among the easiest Intermediate maps: long, compact, single lane.
maps.placement: Right of the skull or below the line from the entrance; boats at the top of the pool.

recommended.note: From the top of the pool it hits above the skull with both sides; 3-2-0 with Berserker Brew.

maps.name: Sulfur Springs
maps.summary: By consensus the easiest Intermediate map: loops give towers many chances.
maps.placement: The central spring and the land around it; very long-range towers and ones using the small front bend excel.

recommended.note: On one of the three low rocks its balls bounce off the walls and rehit bloons.

maps.name: Water Park
maps.summary: One of the most challenging Intermediate maps.
maps.placement: Heli Pilots handle the alternating lanes; limited-range towers go on the pink slide to see both paths.

recommended.note: Little weakness to alternating lanes; Glue Storm and Geraldo's Sharpening Stone complete it.
On the pink slide it reaches both lanes.

maps.name: Another Brick
maps.summary: One of the easiest Advanced maps despite the walls: bendy and fairly long.
maps.placement: Use towers that see over walls (Aircraft Carrier, Wizards with Guided Magic).

recommended.note: Sees past the wall and uses the whole track; 5-2-0 is stronger here. Pair with Admiral Brickell.

maps.name: Ascent
maps.summary: Added in v56. One of the easiest Advanced maps: long paths and few blockers. Most Military towers do well.
maps.placement: Heli Pilots on Pursuit can get confused by the two paths.

recommended.note: On the middle bottom-right platform it covers both paths near the end and can share Jungle Drums.
A submerged Sub at the start decamos everything; use 3-0-1 for consistent decamo.

maps.name: Cargo
maps.summary: Hard mid game because both lanes are active at once; early and late game are effectively single lane.
maps.placement: Early: right of the MOAB lane. After round 39: as much defense as possible below the MOAB lane's first bend. Boats right of the MOAB exit.

recommended.note: Near the front he trivialises the single-lane early game and farms mana.

maps.name: Castle Revenge
maps.summary: One of the hardest Advanced maps (only Erosion and X Factor are rated harder). The valve at the back blocks Perma-Spike's best spot.
maps.placement: You need separate defenses for each lane or global towers that cover both.

recommended.note: Its spikes cover both lanes, handle DDTs that Giant Condor can't, and crack ZOMG shells.

maps.name: Cornfield
maps.summary: Usually seen as one of the easiest Advanced maps: the longest, with cheap corn removal later.
maps.placement: There are four secret spots for No Harvest challenges (2nd, 5th and 6th bends, and above the 3rd).

recommended.note: Balls bounce off the corn patches and rehit bloons; it makes the map simple in every mode.

maps.name: Dark Path
maps.summary: A dark take on Park Path; tied with Another Brick and Off The Coast as one of the easiest Advanced maps.
maps.placement: The high platform over the centre fits limited-range and support towers; Mortars love the middle loops.

recommended.note: The middle loops give them huge power; Artillery Battery saves up to Pop and Awe with little help.

maps.name: Enchanted Glade
maps.summary: One of the easier Advanced maps thanks to long lanes and a central chokepoint.
maps.placement: Use the bottom-centre space, the area just below the centre, or global towers.

recommended.note: The long alternating lanes suit its vines; it carries the early game.
Affordable with Rosalia's discount and strong here.

maps.name: Erosion
maps.summary: Easy outside CHIMPS (sunk towers refund cash), but the collapsing land and short final track make it one of the hardest Advanced maps.
maps.placement: Use global towers on the top-right, teleportable towers, or Arctic Wind ice platforms early.

recommended.note: His spirit pops from anywhere and Spirit Walk (level 7) lets him move as land sinks.

modeNotes.chimps: Keep almost everything on the permanent platform: towers that sink in CHIMPS give no cash back.

maps.name: Geared
maps.summary: One of the hardest Advanced maps because the rotation breaks early-game towers; the late game is average.
maps.placement: Sniper Monkeys are usually the only affordable early option; then global towers (Comanche Defense, Spectre).

recommended.note: His spirit and Spear ignore the rotation and trivialise the early game.

modeNotes.chimps: The early game is the hard part, especially in CHIMPS and Half Cash.

maps.name: High Finance
maps.summary: Average Advanced difficulty; the initial space covers both lanes well enough for a whole strategy.
maps.placement: Heli Pilots do well on the alternating single lanes.

recommended.note: 5-2-0 is preferred here; Brickell's Naval Tactics gives it full DDT popping.

maps.name: Last Resort
maps.summary: A wintry revenge version of Resort; moderately hard because of short straight-line rounds and fast alternating lanes.
maps.placement: Land is scarce; plan placements carefully.

recommended.note: On straight-line rounds, aim its reticle at the start of the outer loop when bloons near the exit to drag them back.

maps.name: Mesa
maps.summary: One of the hardest Advanced maps: two lanes and confusing targeting.
maps.placement: The section just top-right of the centre reaches both lanes; rock growths avoid line-of-sight issues.

recommended.note: Tanks leaks from both lanes caused by the confusing targeting.

maps.name: Midnight Mansion
maps.summary: Moderately hard in CHIMPS, but by far the hardest map for Freeplay: no farm space and only two spots for large towers.
maps.placement: Use the bends; large towers (Villages, Super Monkeys) compete for two spots.

modeNotes.freeplay: The wiki calls it by far the hardest Freeplay map: no room for Banana Farms or several big T5s at once.

maps.name: Mushroom Grotto
maps.summary: Added in v54. Towers can't see or hit bloons in the dark; the early game is hardest, and it gets easier from the 20s once mushrooms are lit.
maps.placement: You don't have to light the mushrooms: some towers do better without them.

recommended.note: With no mushrooms lit, all its spikes land on the middle section, concentrating damage.

maps.name: Off The Coast
maps.summary: One of the easiest Advanced maps: fairly long and single lane; the start and exit are both in the water.
maps.placement: Lots of land and water, so most strategies work.

recommended.note: Strong mid game and an easy save-up; mini-Comanche thresholds line up with the three wide loops.
Its planes cover the lack of compact sections and can nearly solo into the 80s.

maps.name: Party Parade
maps.summary: One of the harder Advanced maps, close to an easy Expert: both short lanes are completely separated.
maps.placement: Snipers only reach one side, and Heli Pilots on Pursuit shuttle between lanes uselessly.

recommended.note: Unbothered by the wall and dual lanes; Advanced-map levelling gets him to level 14 in time for MOABs.
With one range buff (Village or Etienne) its zombies reach both lanes.

maps.name: Pat's Pond
traits: Two lanes far apart in the middle
maps.summary: Unusual: the lanes split far apart in the middle, so strategies cram short-range towers at one entrance.
maps.placement: The right entrance is used more (the BAD exits there, giving time to build up). Global towers tend to chase between lanes.

recommended.note: Thrives where only small parts of the map are usable.

maps.name: Peninsula
maps.summary: Slightly above-average Advanced difficulty; once considered the 4th hardest map before newer maps and tower buffs.
maps.placement: Water and the single lane suit boat strategies.

recommended.note: One of the few win conditions that sees over the mountain and uses the whole track; strong through the 80s.

maps.name: Ship Capture
traits: Four short paths merging into two
maps.summary: New in v57 (a community-designed map). Average Advanced difficulty, a bit like Dark Castle: very short lanes that converge.
maps.placement: Removing the hatch opens water strategies; stalling matters; high-range towers like the Desperado cover both lanes.

recommended.note: Target the spot between the two main lanes to catch everything.

recommended.upgrade: Abyssal Warrior / Lord of the Abyss
recommended.note: Excellent cleanup from the central water.

maps.name: Spillway
maps.summary: Not especially hard: bloons spend a long time in the central loop.
maps.placement: Mortars reach the middle; removing the valves later opens many spots.

recommended.note: 2-5-0 covers most of the central loop and hits many DDTs at once; pair with Striker Jones.

modeNotes.chimps: Start with a Ninja on the centre barrel, then a 1-0-0 Wizard or a hero like Psi at 2-0-1.

maps.name: Sunken Columns
maps.summary: Slightly easier than average: large top and bottom bends where both paths overlap.
maps.placement: Put limited-range towers at the overlapping bends.

recommended.note: The overlaps amplify Sword Charge; add Relentless and Super Glue stuns.
Strong coverage at the overlapping bends.

maps.name: Sunset Gulch
maps.summary: A middle-tier Advanced map: splitting exits and poor central coverage.
maps.placement: Treat it as a short single lane: build the main defense near the end and guard the short MOAB exit; use the left side early.

recommended.note: The straight MOAB path lets its knockback and pierce work fully; 2-0-5 is preferred.

maps.name: Underground
maps.summary: Near-average Advanced difficulty: short, but many spots cover both lanes.
maps.placement: The centre and the spaces above and below it; stalling support like Relentless Glue is very useful.

recommended.note: At the far left or right of the central space she clears the early rounds and covers both lanes late with stun support.

maps.name: X Factor
maps.summary: Generally seen as the hardest Advanced map: two lanes each round from changing spawns and erratic bloon movement.
maps.placement: Global towers struggle with two lanes; limited-range towers can't reach half the map.

recommended.note: Attacks any bloon on the map and catches leaks on long unguarded sections.

maps.name: Blons
maps.summary: The shortest map (red bloons exit in 3.5 seconds on Hard), but single lane with tons of space, so Bloody Puddles, Ravine and X Factor are usually rated harder.
maps.placement: Short-range towers at the bend lose almost nothing on a track this small.

recommended.upgrade: Sauda / Pat Fusty / Tack Shooter / Ice Monkey
recommended.note: Short range barely matters here; Arctic Wind effectively slows Ceramics map-wide.
Ability spikes all land on the tiny track.

maps.name: Bloody Puddles
traits: Five paths, spawns change every round
maps.summary: Generally considered the hardest map in the game: bloons spawn far apart and the spawn points change every round.
maps.placement: The early game needs precise placement and some luck.

recommended.note: Pulls bloons into a single lane, turning most two-spawn rounds into one lane for low-range towers.

maps.name: Dark Castle
maps.summary: Very short, but the converging exit and open space make it by consensus the second-easiest Expert map.
maps.placement: Spike Factories on the castle at the right are especially useful.

recommended.note: The converging exit lets it tank leaks and cover weaknesses like Avatar of Wrath against DDTs.

maps.name: Dark Dungeons
maps.summary: Considered by some a True Expert map (around the 5th hardest). The mid game is hardest; late game is mostly two blimp lanes.
maps.placement: Walls cut Sniper sightlines early; plan for the top MOAB path from the mid game.

recommended.note: Both MOAB lanes have good bends for her.

maps.name: Flooded Valley
traits: Land towers can't see over the wall
maps.summary: Land towers are useless early unless they see over walls; water towers dominate the start. Overlap hides leaks.
maps.placement: Global or long-range towers on a rock; otherwise wait for Silas or Arctic Wind.

recommended.note: Lets land towers go on water early; his level 7 ability with Ice Monkeys or Icicles clears Ceramics and MOABs.

maps.name: Glacial Trail
traits: Towers freeze periodically by placement round
maps.summary: Towers freeze on a schedule based on the round they were placed; if all your key towers freeze together you lose.
maps.placement: Space key towers' placement rounds apart (check Stats → Round Placed); place most late-game towers on rounds ending in 2 or 4.

modeNotes.chimps: You can't sell towers about to freeze, so plan which towers each round needs and place them on time.

maps.name: Infernal
maps.summary: Generally the easiest Expert map, especially in CHIMPS: the longest Expert lanes and one entrance per round.
maps.placement: Alternating-lane towers excel: Heli Pilots, Snipers and Dartlings.

recommended.note: 0-5-2 Elite Sniper and 0-2-5 Elite Defender with Jungle Drums and Stronger Stimulant save to Permanent Brew, then spam Snipers.

maps.name: Muddy Puddles
maps.summary: A very hard early game, but tower buffs made the rest easier; no longer considered True Expert.
maps.placement: Early towers must cover several lanes; long-range strategies excel. Late game, the first lane is easiest; focus local defense on lanes two and three.

maps.name: #Ouch
maps.summary: A True Expert map: four short lanes all active every round.
maps.placement: Water strategies (Destroyers with Permanent Brew) do well; wide-area towers in the middle excel.

recommended.note: From the central water its range covers all four lanes and stalls MOABs and DDTs.
With the water drained, it's a strong Black Border pick with Shinobi Tactics.

maps.name: Quad
maps.summary: Looks easy but is a True Expert map, by consensus the third hardest: lanes are far apart and overlaps hide leaks.
maps.placement: Use separate defense clusters for the top and bottom halves.

recommended.note: The overlaps let Sword Charge hit every bloon twice; add stuns like Relentless Glue.

maps.name: Ravine
maps.summary: By consensus the second-hardest map.
maps.placement: The bottom-left space is surrounded by all four lanes; Monkey Aces ignore the blockers; stalls like Relentless Glue are vital.

recommended.note: Ignores the blockers and shreds high-health blimps late.

maps.name: Sanctuary
maps.summary: Hard early because platforms move towers, easier later where paths overlap; about as hard as Workshop.
maps.placement: Use the overlapping middle section for the mid and late game.

recommended.note: A precise spot on the bottom-middle platform with Set Target, a Village and Stronger Stimulant tanks all leaks.
Spear makes the hard early game much easier.

maps.name: Tricky Tracks
maps.summary: One of the less mechanically annoying Expert maps (v52 notes); a later speed-up may have made it harder.
maps.placement: Cover the separated lanes with long-range or seeking towers; crowd control in the middle of each track.

recommended.note: Its range covers the separated lanes in the mid game.

maps.name: Workshop
maps.summary: Bloons move 50% faster, which makes the CHIMPS early game tough, but the single exit makes it one of the easier Expert maps.
maps.placement: Three Dart Monkeys in precise spots for the first rounds.

recommended.note: Fast bloons and one exit make Spike Factories excellent at tanking leaks.
